entries.en: First write an introduction, for example "I like DeepSeek and Claude".

entries.en: First check the code effects, then confirm the official gameplay. Suggested values not yet connected to combat.

entries.en: First move to generate speed, then enable one bounce.

entries.zh: 光框、格地或影板需要平整且无遮挡的空地。
entries.en: Light frames, grid floors, or shadow boards require flat and unobstructed open space.

entries.zh: 入口已放置，再移动到出口位置按 F。
entries.en: Entrance placed, then move to the exit position and press F.

entries.zh: 公共低重力 · 出区恢复
entries.en: Public low gravity · restore when leaving zone

entries.zh: 共用索道 · 方向键减速 / Q 松开

entries.en: Shared cableway · endpoint E to ride / Q to release

entries.en: Press use key again to detonate; pick up or hit twice to defuse

entries.zh: 冲击环沿地面扩散；跳过薄环可躲开
entries.en: Shockwave ring spreads along the ground; jump over thin rings to dodge

entries.en: Freeze ice surface · Inertia steering / Jump off / Absorbent pad

entries.zh: 凸起亮格弹跳 · 暗格安全
entries.en: Raised bright tiles bounce · Dark tiles safe

entries.en: Exit must be within 1.6–8 meters, clearly visible, and have standing space.

entries.en: The other end must be 1.2–5m away and unobstructed, move and press F again.

entries.en: Only use first-person facts explicitly written by the user; absolutely do not add common sense, associations, school history, campus, culture, or other external knowledge.

entries.en: Return only JSON {"appearance":{complete appearance configuration},"reason":"brief Chinese styling rationale"}.

entries.en: At most one Persona per fact; when there is only one game-able fact, return at most one.

entries.en: Swing around anchor · move along tangent / Q release rope

entries.en: Fixes one unheld normal crate or barrel, blocks wind and suction; grabbing instantly unclamps, two hits to break

entries.en: Ground screen blocks one projectile passing through the surface; both sides can walk through; no accelerated reclaim

entries.en: Ground life is already beside you; still need E to complete reclaim or swallow.

entries.en: Ground real Persona splits left and right by original owner, once per item; any player E reverses, no reclaim no swallow

entries.en: Ground tied to original anchor, first dangerous fall pulls back, still drops one real life, must reclaim after rope breaks

entries.en: Ground step only causes brief stop; jump to break free, spray rain clears

entries.en: Ground enters alert circle and explodes after 0.6 seconds; leave or jump over to dodge

entries.en: Too many effects on field, please wait for one effect to end before using.

entries.en: Field devices need flat open ground, cannot be under people's feet, off the map, or on other mechanisms.

entries.en: Universities are not limited by fame, country, or official website domain; school abbreviations are also recognized as universities, and universities.name must be the abbreviation or school name the user actually wrote, and must not be secretly changed to a name not in the original text.

entries.en: Lasso needs a nearby unobstructed character in front; cannot lasso the same one twice.

Curious exploration → discover light ring

Only hints at already public objects, does not peek into backpack

entries.en: If it is a horizontal combined logo containing a school crest and school name text, select the complete school crest graphic and exclude the adjacent school name text.

entries.en: If there are multiple color versions or duplicate school crests, select only one standard color school crest; do not put multiple logos together on the frisbee.

entries.en: Each of the 16 MBTI types has a different default ability, shown beside its option.

entries.zh: 可改选已有16种能力；文字道具跟随装备生效。外观推荐另在衣橱保存。
entries.en: Choose from 16 abilities. Word abilities follow the equipped item. Save outfit recommendations separately in your wardrobe.

entries.zh: 前方两次各削60韧，完整命中击倒掉落；侧绕或墙体挡火
entries.en: Two frontal 60-stability pulses knock down and drop a Persona; dodge sideways or behind walls

entries.zh: 走动留下湿迹，对手踩中击倒掉落一次；跳过安全，Q停止
entries.en: Leave wet footprints: opponents touching them fall and drop once; jump over them, Q to stop

entries.zh: 对手踩入沙地击倒掉落一次；跳过、绕行或两击拆除
entries.en: Sand contact knocks opponents down and drops once; jump, go around, or hit twice to dismantle

entries.zh: 对手踩中胶场击倒掉落一次；跳过、喷雨清除或两击拆除
entries.en: Glue contact knocks opponents down and drops once; jump, wash away, or dismantle with two hits

entries.zh: 将已有湿迹凝结，对手踩中击倒掉落一次；跳过或浴球擦除
entries.en: Freeze existing wet spots; opponents touching ice fall and drop once; jump or dry it with a sponge

entries.zh: 两次F放线；跑步跨线击倒掉落一次，步行或跳过安全
entries.en: F twice to place a tripwire; running across knocks down and drops once; walk or jump safely

entries.zh: 预告0.7秒后低杆扫动，接触击倒掉落；跳过安全，根部可拆
entries.en: Low sweep after a 0.7s warning knocks down and drops on contact; jump over or dismantle the base

entries.zh: 近距离向上击倒并掉落；侧绕避开，起身保护有效
entries.en: Close frontal uppercut knocks down and drops; dodge sideways, get-up protection applies

entries.zh: 先跳起再F，落地震荡击倒掉落；跳起或墙体可躲避
entries.en: Jump then F: landing pulse knocks down and drops; jumping or walls protect you
